Permanent teeth in the mouth row, the upper and lower dental arches are rounded, and the anterior segments of the upper and lower dentitions are crowded; 3. The bilateral molars have a neutral relationship, the anterior teeth cover 4 mm deeply, the overbite is deep, the midlines of the upper and lower dentitions are uneven, and the upper and lower anterior teeth are labially inclined. ; 4.
